maintenance_rules: Regenerate annotated_pages after any change to region detection or classification logic
Regenerate balloon_renders after any change to crop padding or context extraction
Regenerate depth_maps after any change to DA-V2 model or input plots
Keep before/after boxing variants for all new annotated pages
Preserve inverted and depth-field variants when generated
Update this manifest when new artifact classes are added
Regenerate DA-V2 depth maps after any change to input plots or encoder selection
Keep 4x zoom variants synchronized with 1x crops for pix2pix training pairs

depth_vs_mathematical_structure.statement: Depth Anything V2 estimates VISUAL depth, not mathematical geometry. A depth map of a 2D equation crop is not automatically a reconstruction of the equation's mathematical structure.
examples: A fraction bar may be visually prominent but does not encode numerator-denominator semantics.
A superscript may be spatially elevated but is not necessarily represented as a distinct depth object.
Adjacent symbols may have similar depth despite belonging to different mathematical structures.
A rainbow color-depth visualization is a display representation, not the underlying depth measurement.

evaluation_dimensions.visual_consistency: Repeatable output under the same configuration
evaluation_dimensions.boundary_correspondence: Alignment with independently identified source regions
evaluation_dimensions.structural_preservation: Retention of mathematical symbol and layout relationships
evaluation_dimensions.reconstruction_fidelity: Agreement with independently established source geometry

depth_vs_mathematical_structure.rule: Do not let a successful depth-generation run stand in for any of the last four dimensions.

lineage_schema.description: Required provenance fields for every generated artifact
lineage_schema.rule: Regeneration should create a new version or execution record rather than silently replacing historical outputs. Otherwise, an artifact can retain the same filename while representing a different transformation.

equation_reconciliation.explanation: Cross-reference records (46,105) > registry equations (40,132) because a single equation can generate multiple correspondence records (region-equation pairs, text boundaries, partial matches). The difference of 1,808 equals the contribution of the two newly added papers (0806.2366: 432 + 1212.0957: 1,376).

depth_derived_images_in_ocr_path.scope: 7 crops from 1 page of 1 paper (2009.00031 p5) using Pix2Text 1.1.7
depth_derived_images_in_ocr_path.rationale: Depth transformation does not preserve the image information Pix2Text needs to recognize mathematical glyphs. Original crops remain canonical OCR inputs. Depth artifacts add analytical value without becoming substitutes for their source.
depth_derived_images_in_ocr_path.not_a_universal_claim: This is a scoped engineering decision from 7 crops on 1 page of 1 paper. It does not claim that every depth representation is unsuitable for every OCR system or future recognition architecture.

versioned_evidence_records.subject: Pix2Text OCR quality comparison: original vs depth-derived crops
versioned_evidence_records.environment: Pix2Text 1.1.7, DA-V2 vits encoder, input_size=518, colormap Spectral_r

results.original_crop: best recognition among tested inputs; recovered symbols and expressions (crop_00 c=, crop_01 f^(ell) x f, crop_03 =, crop_04 o, crop_05 sigma; crops 02 and 06 empty)
results.depth_grayscale: mostly empty or incorrect; occasional symbol recovery (crop_04 sigma, crop_05 sigma; others empty)
results.depth_color: almost entirely empty; only crop_00 gave =
results.combined_original_depth: one observed extra prime in f' vs original f — potential hallucination/interference

bbox_evidence.page_level: 229 regions, 98.6% region-text overlap, 0 out-of-bounds centers, 0 page-exceeding regions

versioned_evidence_records.conclusion: Original crops are canonical OCR input. Depth-derived images excluded from Pix2Text path. Combined images rejected as trusted OCR input due to hallucination risk.
versioned_evidence_records.causal_attribution_status: not yet proven — controlled ablation (original alone, depth alone, combined under identical settings) needed to isolate whether depth channel caused extra prime
versioned_evidence_records.next_step: Add controlled ablation experiment if causal attribution becomes required

math_extraction_path.name: Math Extraction Path
math_extraction_path.flow: Original crop -> Pix2Text / OCR -> candidate LaTeX -> MathML or structural parsing -> validation
math_extraction_path.output: candidate LaTeX, MathML, structural equation representation
math_extraction_path.rule: Depth-derived images are excluded from this path. Original pixels are retained as canonical input.

depth_analysis_path.name: Depth Analysis Path
depth_analysis_path.flow: Original crop -> Depth Anything V2 -> grayscale / color / combined artifacts -> point cloud or mesh / spatial analysis
depth_analysis_path.input: original crop pixels (same source crop identity)
depth_analysis_path.output: depth maps, color depth, combined artifacts, point clouds, spatial analysis
depth_analysis_path.rule: Derived visual representation. Adds analytical value (3D reconstruction, boundary detection, spatial analysis) without becoming a substitute for the source.

shared_provenance.rule: Both paths retain shared source-crop identity, bbox, source-page locator, and provenance record. Neither derived representation replaces the original.

pipeline_boundary.preservation_principle: Derived representations can add analytical value without becoming substitutes for their source. Original pixels remain canonical for all downstream math extraction and recognition tasks.
